snippet.title: Alien Strike Blasting the Intruders - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Blast through alien hordes in an explosive run-n-gun chaos.

In Alien Strike: Blasting the Intruders, slide, jump, and shoot in 8 directions across fast-paced stages built for pure action. Play solo or with up to 3 players, swap weapons in real time, activate insane specials, and fight massive alien bosses in a retro-inspired invasion full of mayhem.

Every run is a nonstop test of reflexes, coordination, and firepower.

Play Alien Strike: Blasting the Intruders now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2876150/Alien_Strike_Blasting_the_Intruders/
